title: Topic 20
japanese_text: 鉄<u>欠乏</u>性<u>貧血</u>は、鉄分の不足が原因の貧血で、特に<u>生理</u>のある女性に起こりやすい。最近は、食べ物にかけて手軽に<u>摂取できる粉末</u>タイプのサプリメントもあるので、鉄不足が気になる人は調べてみるといいだろう。
english_translation: Iron deficiency anemia is caused by insufficient iron, and is especially likely to occur in women who have periods. Recently, there are powdered supplements that can be easily taken with food, so anyone concerned about iron deficiency should look into them.
